evals.prompt: Audit the SEO on this Astro site and propose the first changes.
evals.expected_behavior: Confirms this is an Astro site and reads astro.config.* (site origin, adapter, i18n) before proposing any canonical, sitemap, or OG change, treating a missing or local-only site config as blocking.
assertions: Reads astro.config.* and confirms the production site origin before proposing canonical/sitemap/OG work
Checks package.json and whether @jdevalk/astro-seo-graph is already installed
Treats a missing or local-only site config as a blocking issue rather than proceeding anyway

evals.prompt: Our Astro site already has a working hand-rolled SEO setup with good metadata and a sitemap, but we're missing structured data and llms.txt. Fix the gaps.
evals.expected_behavior: Recommends the smallest coherent implementation path: preserve the existing hand-rolled setup where it already works and add only the missing structured data and llms.txt pieces, rather than replacing the whole stack.
assertions: Does not propose replacing the existing SEO stack when it already satisfies the working requirements
Scopes the implementation to the actually missing pieces (structured data, llms.txt)
Only suggests @jdevalk/astro-seo-graph if it materially simplifies the missing pieces, not as a default rip-and-replace

evals.prompt: Audit the SEO on this Astro site and propose the first changes, then implement the missing pieces.
evals.expected_behavior: Audits the major SEO surfaces (metadata, structured data, OG images, sitemap/robots/RSS, indexing, agent-discovery surfaces), implements the missing pieces, and verifies canonical/metadata/schema/OG output on representative pages before finishing.
assertions: Covers head metadata/canonicals, structured data, OG images, sitemap/robots/RSS, and indexing surfaces in the audit
Runs the project's Astro validation path (astro check and/or npm run build) or confirms it was run
Verifies resulting canonical, metadata, schema, and OG output on representative pages rather than assuming correctness
Mentions writing-and-editing only for generated short strings or prose follow-up, not as the primary deliverable

evals.prompt: Check these title tags and descriptions for truncation and rewrite weak ones.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes the copy-only metadata review away from Astro technical SEO implementation and toward writing-and-editing in metadata-audit mode.
assertions: Does not treat copy-only metadata review as an Astro SEO implementation task
Recommends writing-and-editing in metadata-audit mode instead of auditing the SEO system

evals.prompt: Set up SEO for a Next.js app — metadata, sitemap, and structured data.
evals.expected_behavior: Declines to apply Astro-specific SEO workflow because the project is not an Astro site, and does not force Astro-specific tooling like @jdevalk/astro-seo-graph onto a Next.js codebase.
assertions: Does not apply the Astro-specific SEO workflow or recommend @jdevalk/astro-seo-graph for a non-Astro project
States the skill is scoped to Astro sites rather than proceeding with generic SEO advice under this skill's workflow
